name: video-editor-web
description: Static web edition of Video Editör: the same editor, running entirely in the browser (WebCodecs + Mediabunny). The optional AI assistant uses a cloud provider with the user's own key, or a model server on the user's own computer that allows browsers (Ollama, LM Studio).
